notes.title: Better Controller Support
notes.content:
Greetings, Sisters!
We’re thrilled to bring you the latest updates for Banzai Escape 2: Subterranean! Here's what’s new:

[b]Patch 45.3[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Limit text character to prevent overflow text limit error 
[*] Fixed when either of player is dead, campaign mission cant proceed
[*] Fixed camera customization glitch on 2nd player coop
[*] Attempt Fixing on chat during mission cant put chat because cant focus chat window (need further test)
[/list]

[b]Patch 45.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Costumes selection sometimes produce error on code
[*] Fixed Coop event enemies wrongly appear causing errors
[/list]

[h1]Better Controller Support[/h1]
Good news, gamepad users! The game now offers enhanced controller support for smoother gameplay. 
Navigating menus is easier than ever with standard control inputs, eliminating the need for mouse cursor simulation.

We’ve tested this update with PlayStation and Xbox controllers. 
For other controller types, the game will default to Xbox controller settings. 
Unfortunately, Steam Deck support isn’t available yet, as it requires a Unity update to configure for the latest Steam Deck devices. 
However, community controller mappings are available as a workaround.

[b]Known Issue[/b]
[list]
[*] Unplugging your controller during gameplay may cause errors, so we recommend keeping your controller connected to avoid interruptions.
[*] If you are alt+tab windows, it will lose focus on selection menu thus rendering controller unusable. To solve this, click any button (by using mouse) to make the selection highlighted again for navigation. This issues will be solve on next update
[*] Some settings might not work and require mouse, such as color hue selection. This is because how to game is made with mouse/keyboard in-mind. It may not be solve on next update
[/list]

[h1]Aim-Assist Added[/h1]
We know that aiming with a controller can be challenging at times, making it difficult to hit your target accurately during intense gameplay. 
To address this, we’ve implemented aim-assist, designed to improve precision and make your shooting more consistent.
This feature is available for both keyboard/mouse and controller users:

[b]Default Sensitivity Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse/Keyboard: 0.1
[*] Controller: 0.5
[/list]
The settings can be adjust in options.
Aim-assist helps you stay on target but still factors in your weapon's accuracy stats, keeping the gameplay fair and skill-based.

[h1]UI for Cover Areas[/h1]
For new players, identifying cover areas can be tricky. To address this, we’ve added a UI indicator that highlights nearby cover areas. 
Now you’ll know where to crouch and take advantage of defilade to avoid enemy fire. most of enemy fire.

[h1]Secured Save Files[/h1]
To those mischievous, traitor sisters tampering with weapon save files—your reign ends here! 
Save files are now more secure, making them significantly harder to modify with basic tools. 
While not completely unhackable, this update adds an extra layer of protection to preserve game integrity.

That’s all for now, Sisters! Happy gaming, and as always, stay vigilant in the subterranean depths!

[h2][b]Patch 45[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Better controller support. Tested on Dualshock, Dualsense, xbox 360 and xbox one controller.
[*] Added aim-assist, Adjustable to user needs.
[*] Theres new UI showing interaction on nearby cover area
[*] Save system are now more encrypted to prevent easilly hacking weapon stats.
[/list]

As always, if you encounter any issues, please let us know!

We encourage you to spread the word about our game to your friends and family. 
Your support helps us reach more players and share the fun!

Thank you for your continued support. Stay tuned for more exciting updates!

Warm regards,
Aisam

notes.title: NEW UI UX and Language
notes.content:
Good day everyone!

Here's I delivered a new updated toward our game! Focus on User Interface and User Experiencing!
As you guys know, the old UI is quite meh meh~ 
So, I take a initiative to overhaul, revamp and redesign the UI for better looks and toward current simplicity trend!

Now! Current UI is lighter and cleaner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/c65c8f58e8ee6a68841350521d4ef3ed0d1f299c.jpg[/img]

New Main Menu look! Now come with news tab for anyone who missing the update news. UI also revamped and the camera are now roaming around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/c31be94150635cd71937eca4e9755fd9136ea534.jpg[/img]

Now the status which showing ammo amount and health bar has moved and grouped into one simplify column on the right side. Simple and eyes can focus that part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/2cd82fe88f15a8d6c3a366b9d870dd729ed67fbf.jpg[/img]

Drop-able items are now showing the status before player can picking it up! This is better management for player to take only what they want.

Apart of all UI redesign, UX for weapon inventory also changed! Make it into simplify by showing DPS count (Damage Per Second). Players are now able to choose wisely which weapon performed better in-term of rate of fire + damage. The other status also available by clicking any weapon item.

Also, now any items can be mark with fav! Favourite items will not be selected to sell if select all button clicked. This to ensure safety during transaction

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/c132a8c989b1a1e6a14a73b57e0a3e3f23313911.png[/img]

New mission update status UI now redesigned to look better! No more static sudden popup into screen

notes.title: Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

What a nice day today! 

Let’s celebrate the release of Banzai Escape 2 Subterranean today! 
After a year of development, we’ve managed to release the game into public! 

Here's the game store page! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1758950/Banzai_Escape_2_Subterranean/

What’s new from this game? 

[h1]ITS FREE![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/73dd53abeb30f5310ddb155e29ae60e20c08974f.png[/img]

We’ve responded to some of our fans stating that they cannot purchase the game. 
So, we’ve decided to make this game free to play! The full game! They can play the game until end. 
We only charge for new DLC content such costumes or missions. 
What you need is steam installed on your pc then you can install the game and play it.

[h1]2-PLAYER MODE! [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/384466c28d95531167f7ee17649597b1c8147754.png[/img]

Yes, this game is now online! 
You can play with your friend as second player through steam invitation. 
Ask your friend by inviting them to play together into the subterranean dungeon. 
This way you can finish the levels together with ease! 

[h1]CUSTOMIZABLE COSTUMES / SKINS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/be4dc59454b35d4a9fa6968130b854e8aba1a3bc.png[/img]

This time you can change your characters appearance with a wide variety of costumes. 
Feel free to customise your character to your liking and show off to your partner! 
Extra outfits can bought through paid DLC which gives you a selection of better and cool looking costumes 

and of course many more features! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244296/87ed30c493cbfa55adf3b322aa9adbcdf0e0e982.png[/img]
Beware! Although this game is released, it’s still part of Early Access. 
There may be bugs that you may encounter randomly, depending on your pc and internet performance. 
If they happen, be sure to report it in discussion pages! 
Furthermore, if you have any ideas / suggestions / feedback or other, head to discussion community for this game! 
You can contribute something for better future of this game. 

In the mean time, to celebrate the release of this game, Banzai Escape 1 and Banzai Escape 2 will be on sale! Help yourself and go buy it! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1230990/Banzai_Escape_2/
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/440340/Banzai_Escape/

Hope You Guys Enjoy it! 

AND PLEASE SHARE THIS GAME TO OTHERS! 

Thank you for all for supporting us up to now!
Aisam :)
